LESSON: ORAL EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.4: Oral Expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Oral Expression, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can one practise active listening skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. compare telling the time in English, Kiswahili and Chinese collaboratively and share their findings,

2. look at a 12-hour clock and say the time using 点 diǎn and 分 fēn,

3. tell the time using 半,刻 and 差 (e.g. 8:30 八点半;6:15 六点一刻;4:45 差 一刻五点),

4. say the time in a.m. and p.m. using 早上, 上午, 下午, 晚上 in turns (e.g. 7:30 p.m. 晚上 7 点半),

5. work together to ask for the time (e.g. 现 在几点?现在 9 点 55 分。),

6. talk about the specific times they undertake various subjects at their school with peers (e.g. 我们几点上汉语课?我 们明天 8 点中上汉语课。),

7. discuss the importance of having a to do list to enable them effectively meet their set goals collaboratively.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. compare telling the time in English, Kiswahili and Chinese collaboratively and share their findings,
2. look at a 12-hour clock and say the time using 点 diǎn and 分 fēn,
3. tell the time using 半,刻 and 差 (e.g. 8:30 八点半;6:15 六点一刻;4:45 差 一刻五点),
4. say the time in a.m. and p.m. using 早上, 上午, 下午, 晚上 in turns (e.g. 7:30 p.m. 晚上 7 点半),
5. work together to ask for the time (e.g. 现 在几点?现在 9 点 55 分。),
6. talk about the specific times they undertake various subjects at their school with peers (e.g. 我们几点上汉语课?我 们明天 8 点中上汉语课。),
7. discuss the importance of having a to do list to enable them effectively meet their set goals collaboratively.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Oral Expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: the learner becomes aware of the importance of planning and managing time effectively when they discuss

why having a to do list enables one to meet set goals.

Values:
Unity: the learner collaborates with others when they share their findings of telling time in English, Kiswahili and Chinese to

peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer education and mentorship: the learner discusses with peers and gains a new perspective of how they can effectively achieve

their set goals by keeping a to do list.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links their learning to Mathematics on the use of time to quantify, measure and compare the duration and sequence

of events.
